en-US.heroPrimary: CS 121 / IN4MATX 141 is UCI's information retrieval course: how search engines collect, process, index, and rank web documents.
en-US.heroSecondary: This page collects week-by-week notes for classmates who want a structured review of text processing, the web graph, SEO and spam, web crawling, the ethics and law around collecting web data, and text processing and term-document matrices.
en-US.readerDescription: This page presents {course}{weekPhrase} notes in a structured reading format so you can review text processing, the web graph, SEO, web crawling, and how search engines index and rank pages week by week. The path below takes you back to Notes, Course Notes, the course page, or this note file. Hover over the ≡ icon on the right side to open the Table of Contents.

zh-CN.heroPrimary: CS 121 / IN4MATX 141 是 UCI 的信息检索课程,讲搜索引擎如何收集、处理、索引网页文档并为其排序。
zh-CN.heroSecondary: 这个页面汇总按周整理的课程笔记,方便同学回顾文本处理、网络图、SEO 与垃圾信息、网络爬虫、采集网页数据涉及的伦理与法律问题,以及文本处理与词项-文档矩阵。
zh-CN.readerHeading: 信息检索课程阅读笔记
zh-CN.readerDescription: 这页整理的是 {course}{weekPhrase} 的课程笔记，适合按周复习文本处理、网络图、SEO、网络爬虫，以及搜索引擎如何索引网页并为其排序。下面这条路径可以带你回到 Notes、Course Notes、课程主页，或定位到当前笔记。将鼠标悬停在右侧的 ≡ 图标上可以打开目录。

summary.en-US: What IR is, databases vs. search engines, relevance, classic vs. web IR, search engine architecture, the web graph, users and queries, the ad model, SEO and spam.
summary.zh-CN: 信息检索的定义、数据库与搜索引擎、相关性、传统 IR 与网络 IR、搜索引擎架构、网络图、用户与查询、广告模式、SEO 与垃圾信息。

summary.en-US: URLs, the crawl loop, robots.txt and sitemaps, politeness and performance, DNS, crawler traps, freshness and expected age, distributed and focused crawling, ethics, privacy and copyright.
summary.zh-CN: URL 结构、爬取循环、robots.txt 与 sitemap、礼貌性与性能、DNS、爬虫陷阱、新鲜度与期望年龄、分布式与聚焦爬取、伦理、隐私与版权。

summary.en-US: Format conversion, Unicode and UTF-8, the TREC Web format, compression and BigTable, checksums, n-gram fingerprints, Simhash and content-block extraction.
summary.zh-CN: 格式转换、Unicode 与 UTF-8、TREC Web 格式、压缩与 BigTable、校验和、n-gram 指纹、Simhash 与正文块提取。

summary.en-US: Tokenization, stopping, stemming (suffix-s, Porter, Krovetz), phrases, POS tagging and n-grams, document structure and anchor text, and text statistics with Zipf's law.
summary.zh-CN: 分词、停用词、词干提取（suffix-s、Porter、Krovetz）、短语、词性标注与 n-gram、文档结构与锚文本，以及文本统计与 Zipf 定律。

summary.en-US: From the term-document matrix to the inverted index, postings with counts, positions, extents and scores, docIDs, partial indexes and merging, biword and positional indexes, index-the-index with seek, MapReduce and index updates.
summary.zh-CN: 从词项-文档矩阵到倒排索引、含计数/位置/extent/分数的 postings、docID、部分索引与归并、双词与位置索引、索引的索引与 seek、MapReduce 与索引更新。

label.en-US: Retrieval Models: Boolean, tf-idf & Vector Space
label.zh-CN: 检索模型：布尔、tf-idf 与向量空间

summary.en-US: The Boolean model, the abstract ranking model, Jaccard, bag of words, tf, idf and tf-idf, the vector space model with cosine similarity, SMART notation, zones, proximity, query parsers and aggregate scores.
summary.zh-CN: 布尔模型、排序的抽象模型、Jaccard、词袋、tf/idf/tf-idf、向量空间模型与余弦相似度、SMART 记号、区域打分、邻近度、查询解析器与聚合打分。

summary.en-US: Merging postings for AND, skip pointers and term order, distributed evaluation and caching, DAAT vs TAAT, conjunctive processing, MaxScore, heap top-K, index elimination, champion lists, g(d), high/low lists, impact ordering and tiered indexes.
summary.zh-CN: postings 归并求 AND、跳表指针与词项顺序、分布式查询与缓存、DAAT 与 TAAT、合取处理、MaxScore、堆取 top-K、索引剪枝、冠军列表、g(d)、高低列表、按影响排序与分层索引。

summary.en-US: Hubs and authorities, the base set, the HITS iteration, the random surfer and teleporting, PageRank by iteration and in matrix form, and PageRank in a real engine.
summary.zh-CN: 枢纽页与权威页、基础集、HITS 迭代、随机游走者与远程跳转、PageRank 的迭代与矩阵形式，以及实际引擎中的 PageRank。

summary.en-US: Effectiveness, efficiency and cost, test collections and relevance judgments, pooling, query logs and clickthrough (Skip Above/Next), precision, recall and fallout.
summary.zh-CN: 有效性、效率与成本，测试集与相关性判断，汇集（pooling），查询日志与点击数据（Skip Above/Next），精确率、召回率与误报率。
